items.t: Anthropic Faces a Longer Wait Than SpaceX to Join Stock Indexes
items.d: Anthropic’s planned initial public offering could generate billions of dollars in demand from index-tracking funds, though the artificial intelligence startup may have to wait longer than SpaceX did to join two major stock benchmarks.

items.t: Hadrian Targets Critical Bottleneck in US Shipbuilding
items.d: Defense manufacturer Hadrian is investing $300 million to acquire and modernize a historic Pennsylvania foundry that produces critical components for US Navy ships and submarines. CEO Chris Power discusses why domestic casting capacity has become a major bottleneck for America’s defense industrial base and how AI and advanced manufacturing could boost production. SpaceX Rocket Successfully Catches Part of Starship Rocket
items.d: A SpaceX Starship Rocket successfully returned from orbit and was caught by mechanical arms on the launchpad. It’s the latest milestone as SpaceX hopes to create fully reusable rockets.
